item.title: The 600-year-old origins of the word 'hello'
item.description:
📝 'Hullo, hillo, holla': The 600-year-old origins of the word 'hello'2 hours agoShareSaveJonathan WellsShareSaveSerenity Strull/ BBC(Credit: Serenity Strull/ BBC)It's been 200 years since the word "hello" was first used in print – though its beginnings date back to the 15th Century. Like the go-to greetings in other languages, "hello" also says something about the English-speaking world – depending on which variation, abbreviation or inflection of the word we choose to use. The origins of helloThe pre-printed origins of the word "hello" are disputed.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20260113-hello-hiya-aloha-what-our-greetings-reveal

item.title: Show HN: Streaming gigabyte medical images from S3 without downloading them
item.description:
📝 io: cargo install wsi-streamer Or build from source: git clone https://github. jpg Authentication # Enable HMAC-SHA256 authentication wsi-streamer s3://my-slides --auth-enabled --auth-secret "$SECRET" # Generate signed URLs wsi-streamer sign --path /tiles/slide. Validation # Check S3 connectivity wsi-streamer check s3://my-slides # List available slides wsi-streamer check s3://my-slides --list-slides # Test a specific slide wsi-streamer check s3://my-slides --test-slide sample.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/PABannier/WSIStreamer

item.title: US electricity demand surged in 2025 – solar handled 61% of it
item.description:
📝 A new analysis from global energy think tank Ember shows that solar power accounted for 61% of the growth in US electricity demand last year, highlighting how central solar has become as power demand accelerates. That single jump in solar output covered 61% of all new electricity demand nationwide. With electricity demand surging, the case to build solar has never been stronger,” said Jones.
🔗 Read more: https://electrek.co/2026/01/16/us-electricity-demand-surged-in-2025-solar-handled-61-percent/

item.title: Gut micro-organisms associated with health, nutrition and dietary intervention
item.description:
📝 Here, in over 34,000 US and UK participants with metagenomic, diet, anthropometric and host health data, we identified known and yet-to-be-cultured gut microbiome species associated significantly with different diets and risk factors. We developed a ranking of species most favourably and unfavourably associated with human health markers, called the ‘ZOE Microbiome Health Ranking 2025’. We identified microbiome species consistently associated with more favourable and (inversely) unfavourable health markers across continents.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-09854-7?lid=t94o71j7gslg
